assertions.evidence: @TableTest('''...''')' appears twice, once for each test method

assertions.text: List values in the table use bracket syntax like [tech:java, biz:sales, dev:ci] — not comma-separated strings without brackets.
assertions.evidence: All list columns use [tech:java, biz:sales, dev:ci], [], ['biz:hr|recruiting', ...] bracket syntax

assertions.text: Empty list input uses [] (not a blank cell, which represents null). The distinction between empty list and null is preserved.
assertions.evidence: Empty list stays empty rows show | [] | in both tables, not blank cells

assertions.text: Values containing pipes (|), brackets, or colons (:) are properly quoted (e.g. "tech:java") so they don't conflict with table syntax. Colons without quoting would be mis-interpreted as map key:value entries.
assertions.evidence: tech:java, biz:sales, dev:ci, tech:go unquoted; only pipes/brackets quoted. tech:go in ['biz:hr|recruiting', tech:go]

assertions.text: Set<String> values in the table use curly brace syntax like {tech, dev} — not bracket syntax [tech, dev] which is for lists. The distinction between Set and List types is preserved in the table notation.
assertions.evidence: Required Categories column uses {tech, dev}, {biz}, etc. Curly braces throughout

assertions.text: Cell values containing newlines use \\n escaping — not literal line breaks that would break the table row structure.
assertions.evidence: [tech:java\\nEnterprise Edition, biz:sales] uses \\n escaping in table

assertions.text: Values containing pipe characters (|) are quoted so they don't conflict with the markdown table column separator. For example, a tag like 'biz:hr|recruiting' must be quoted.
Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: Both tables have Scenario as first column header

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?' (e.g. 'Filtered tags?' or 'Result?')
Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: Method bodies contain only stream().map().collect() and assertEquals(); no if/switch

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest — not any other order.
Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title when converted from camelCase/snake_case.
assertions.evidence: @DisplayName('Filter tags by category name') and 'Filter tags by required categories set'

assertions.text: If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +. Passes if @Description is absent.
